name: com.OWNER.game-protection-kit
description: Detects re-uploaded, re-signed and rehosted copies of your Unity game, and stops demo builds from leaking full-game content. Build stamping for leak tracing, IL2CPP enforcement, one-click setup. No DRM: never blocks legit players, sends no data by default.

samples.description: Sends integrity signals to Firebase Analytics. Requires the Firebase Analytics SDK.
Replace the default stolen-copy notice with your own UI, wired in the Inspector.
Template for writing and registering your own integrity check.
